description: 0xSero's M288-12L mosaic of GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 on one Spark with SGLang, from glm-5.3-flash-spark-mosaic at 248dbaa0 (docker/run-spark.sh with the mosaic's measured values, also reachable as start-mosaic.sh in GLM-5.3-Flash-EXL3-1x-DGX-Spark): 12 of the 45 MoE layers at 3.05 bpw and the rest at 2.05 bpw (codebook mul1, 96.1 GB, byte-copy of turboderp's quants), served through upstream's exl3-plain SGLang overlay image (pinned by digest, built on the lmsysorg glm-5.3-flash base) with DSA attention, FP8 E4M3 KV cache, 8192-token context, one request at a time, image input, glm45 reasoning and glm47 tool parsers. CUDA graphs are off and there is no speculative decoding: the mul1 codebook is rejected by the MTP-capable vLLM overlay (see the 0xSero vLLM K2 recipe for the MTP path). Upstream census of the tensors runs first at container start and stops the launch on a layout mismatch. Upstream claims, not measured here: 10.79 tok/s decode and 503.5 tok/s prefill on one Spark, top-1 agreement with BF16 0.80842 versus 0.78902 for the 2.05 bpw baseline, images up to about 8000 tokens each. Licences are informational: repository and weights are MIT. Hardware startup on 2026-10-21 ended with host_memory_exhausted; no later pass is recorded. With absolute token/state caps and 8192-token context and five Mamba state slots (the 2026-10-28 two-slot pool failed SGLang resolve_max_num_reqs, 2 // 5 = 0 requests), estimated need is still 119,501,146,944 bytes per rank, inferred from the pinned geometry rather than measured, versus a 108,470,788,096-byte planning limit. This single-Spark profile requires smaller weights or a distinct larger-topology recipe. The estimate is not a new hardware measurement; physical retesting remains pending. Chat template: upstream's with the standard enable_thinking switch on the generation prompt (<think></think> when a request turns thinking off, <think> otherwise), so the glm45 reasoning parser separates reasoning for requests that turn thinking off as well as for those that leave it on; SGLang's template detection otherwise leaves the parser unforced for enable_thinking=false and the end tag leaks into content.
title: GLM 5.3 Flash EXL3 M288-12L mosaic SGLang single Spark (0xSero)
